description: Generate a customized Privacy Policy and Terms of Use document for your mobile apps

latest_release.body:
# What's Changed

### ✨ Features

- Pure Go build pipeline without Pug or Node.js
- AppFlyer third-party service support
- New commands for formatting, checks, image compression, dependency updates, and local serving

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fix single-platform text generation
- Fix broken review page images
- Fix review page cache-busting
- Improve German translations
- Escape review data before inserting it into the page
- Add graceful server shutdown and port conflict detection
- Fix locale selector labeling

### ⚡ Performance

- Compress downloaded review images and third-party logos
- Resize and optimize sidebar images
- Improve generated asset cache-busting

### 🧪 Testing

- Playwright end-to-end tests
- Add English and German golden HTML checks
- Add comprehensive platform text tests

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nisrulz/app-privacy-policy-generator/compare/5.1.0...5.2.0
